item_desc1011601.en:
An Elixir that helps Cultivators break through Soul Formation and reach Enlightenment.
<g>●</g>Its Recipe can be purchased at <g>Workshops</g> in {mapData108}. The Furnace can be purchased in the <g>Markets</g> or the <g>Treasure Pavilion</g> of sects. Once you've obtained the Elixir Recipe and the Furnace, as well as all the Herbs needed, you can try concocting this Elixir.
<g>●</g>If a sect has abundant <g>Herbs</g>, it may concoct the Elixir and sell it in the <g>Treasure Pavilion</g>.
item_desc1011601.ch:
能够帮助化神境修真者突破至悟道境的丹药，是大部分化神境修真者所追求的目标。
<g>●</g>在{mapData108}中的<g>工坊</g>中可购买丹方，在<g>坊市</g>或宗门的<g>聚宝仙楼</g>中可购买丹炉，集齐丹方所需要的药材，即可炼丹。
<g>●</g>若宗门的<g>药材资源</g>丰富，<g>聚宝仙楼</g>中可能会出现由宗门炼制的此丹。
